column1: # Written for the Switch 2 merge: upstream played this game on a Mac; it has not been played on Android
# a hardware buffer takes all its memory at once, and 5 GB of them left a 12 GB tablet none (gfx_vk_core.c)
# the shaders are translated, so their code in memory pools goes back to the system (hle_nvn.c code_drop)
# buffers and textures share pools: with small chunks the textures stay out of hardware buffers (gfx_vk_core.c lazy_chunk)
# the sun's shadow map: the stopgap for the stripes (gfx_vk_exec.c shadow_pass)
# a compute pipeline can take the driver over a minute: built beside the frame, not in it (gfx_vk_exec.c compute_async)
# its frames run hundreds of dispatches; the barriers between back-to-back dispatches are compute-to-compute, not full ones that flush the colour and depth caches too
# (gfx_vk_gbar.c; Banana Native v0.2.9: less GPU time a frame on Pokopia)
# handheld: the game picks its lower resolution and settings. Docked it asked more of the tablet than its memory and GPU have: under 15 fps in its first area, and closed by Android after 6 minutes
# Docked saved in settings.txt before this row existed does not count (front_android.c settings_load)
# the sticks float: hidden, and under the finger on its half of the window (front_android.c touch_event)
# the render size: the game's dynamic resolution starts from 720p, not 900p to 1080p (loader.c levels_apply; the offsets are Banana Native's, update v655360 only). The pause menu changes it
# the exposure histogram, one frame in three (gfx_vk_exec.c thin_skip)
# the game goes on while the frame is replayed, on the fastest cores: a frame took the two one after the other
# which passes the GPU's time goes to, for the next round of cuts: remove with them
# the frame's Vulkan calls on a thread of their own (gfx_vk_dq.c): replaying takes 14 to 19 ms of a 40 ms frame
# one frame's passes in play, for the stripes on Ditto: remove with them
# the gamepad as in the player's picture (themes/pokopia, devtools/pokopia_hud.py); L3 and R3 added beside the sticks in its style
